Qual campeão foi mais banido na EM em 2026?

resultados.sql:
SELECT c.champion_name
FROM bans b
JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = b.match_id
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT champion_id, champion_name FROM participants) c ON c.champion_id = b.champion_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.game_creation) = 2026
GROUP BY c.champion_name
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT b.match_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

registros.pergunta: Quantos banimentos MasterYi recebeu?

resultados.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS banimentos
FROM bans b
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT champion_id, champion_name FROM participants) c
  ON c.champion_id = b.champion_id
WHERE c.champion_name = 'Master Yi';

registros.pergunta: Quais os 5 campeões com a maior média de ouro obtido jogando de UTILITY?

resultados.sql:
SELECT p.champion_name, AVG(p.gold_earned) AS media_ouro
FROM participants p
WHERE p.team_position = 'UTILITY'
GROUP BY p.champion_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY media_ouro DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;

registros.pergunta: Quanto é o win rate de Veigar?

resultados.sql:
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN pp.win THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS win_rate
FROM pro_players pp
JOIN pro_games pg ON pg.game_id = pp.game_id AND pg.side = pp.side
WHERE pp.champion = 'Veigar' AND pg.year = 2026;
